Issue-Driven.definition: Derived directly from historical GitHub issues/defects. Focuses on localized single-point bug repair under low distortion.

Expert-Exploratory.definition: Simulates open scientific exploration where root cause of a complex discrepancy or anomaly is unknown; requires domain knowledge reasoning.

Engineering-Integration.definition: Goes beyond single-point repair to connect multi-module capability chains, pipeline gaps, and system architecture across files.

Issue-Driven.mechanism: The code-derived graph provides direct structural localization to the defective function (e.g. 074, 103, 077), giving Science a distinct edge over blind keyword search.

Expert-Exploratory.mechanism: When the bug is a simple plumbing/indexing issue disguised as an anomaly (e.g. 022), scientific context can induce cognitive anchoring—the agent over-deliberates on physics formulas instead of fixing the trivial string mapping.

Engineering-Integration.mechanism: Both arms hit the benchmark's architectural boundary—requires broad multi-file component stitching where single-turn patches face the greatest challenge.
